name: populate-quick-plot-stack
description: Pip-installs the scientific Python stack into the `quick-plot-stack` EFS layer for use by the `quick-plot` workflow. Triggered manually via POST /runs. The EFS layer must be created first via POST /compute-nodes/{nodeId}/layers (status EMPTY); this workflow populates it.

defaultParams.REQUIREMENTS:
matplotlib
seaborn
pandas
numpy
scipy
flowkit
fcsparser
anndata
scanpy
nibabel
tifffile
pillow
pyreadr
pyarrow
h5py
pyedflib
